summary: Aligns the Cloud sign-in and organization finder with Carbon’s responsive grid and spacing scale.
userImpact: Sign-in providers, the organization finder form and alternate entry links share the same alignment on desktop and mobile.
Email and organization-name errors appear after pressing Continue, leaving the alternate entry actions available while switching.
documentation: The existing Cloud organization finder uses Carbon Grid, Column, Tile and Stack components.
rollback: Redeploy the previous compatible application images.
validation: Browser checks cover responsive grid geometry, form validation and the existing Cloud sign-in journey.

customerDocumentation.reason: The sign-in options and workflow remain the same.
